constant_string.item: Save your current Mii character to your computer as a .mii binary file. If you ever want to reload your Mii into the editor, you can use the Load option to load this file to get your character back.
Load Mii characters from your computer into the Mii Editor. Valid Mii files include .mii binary files or Mii's saved as XML.
View the XML for your current Mii character. You can edit the XML to have its changes affect your Mii or save the XML to your computer as an .xml file.
Export your Mii character to your computer as a bitmap image. You can choose between JPEG or PNG formats.
The Mii Editor is not online. Load, Save and Export are disabled.
